description.value: New Aiyansh Gas Bar is a convenience store and gas station serving the community of New Aiyansh (Gitlaxt'aamiks) in the Nass Valley of northwestern BC. Located in a remote region of the North Coast, it represents a rare service stop for touring cyclists navigating this sparse and scenic route. The combination of fuel and convenience goods makes it a likely resupply point on an otherwise isolated stretch of road.
